Job Description

The Role AMX is an award-winning IT consultancy specialising in work management, collaboration & digital transformation for medium & large enterprises. As the leading Smartsheet and Miro partner in Europe, we help organisations increase productivity & drive innovation. To further expand our success, we are currently looking for a dedicated student as Junior Solution Consultant: Developing and presenting innovative proof of concepts to demonstrate the capabilities of our solutions Design and implement Smartsheet.com solutions , such as project portfolio management with eye-catching dashboards Create and deploy Miro.com solutions , like process diagrams or PMO solutions Assistance in training sessions with relevant stakeholders to ensure a successful change management process Taking on sub-projects in the customer process from initial contact to the successful implementation of the project Support management by researching prospects, customers, and industries and creating account overviews using the leading CRM software, Salesforce Your profile You are currently studying a bachelor's or master's in business management/administration, economics, computer science or a related field at a German university and have initial experience from working student activities/internships Strong communication skills that allow you to convey complex ideas and concepts in an understandable way Passion for software and digital technologies . Practical experience with Excel and PowerPoint is a plus Creative problem solver who likes to bring in his own ideas and works independently Work collaboratively in an international team environment You speak fluent English and German, additional languages are a plus Why us? Career start: We value long-term relationships and offer the opportunity of a permanent position as a Junior Consultant after a successful degree Amazing team: Work with and learn from a talented, highly motivated and international team Diversity of perspectives: We are observant, curious, and challenge the status quo and always look for potential improvements Become part of our global team where fully remote work in Germany isn't just feasible; it's celebrated. Our culture revolves around effective communication, trust & recognition, fostering a supportive & dynamic environment despite the remote setting Flexible Work: Enjoy a flexible work culture with remote work options and flexible hours to help you maintain a healthy balance between work, school, and your personal life. Cutting-Edge Technology: Work with the best technology on the market: Smartsheet.com, Salesforce.com, Google Suite, Calendly, and much more Customized benefits through our partner Probonio Responsibility from Day 1.
